# Ordinary array ownership: original MathJax 3.2.2 references

These references preserve 6,124 distinct `(tex, display)` inputs captured from D2's frozen MathJax 3.2.2, commit `ad8f5c21cb810236551da8c6512ba733e67357ee`. Every input uses a fresh original runtime, explicit display mode, `em=16`, `ex=8`, and no font cache. Expected SVGs and original exceptions are never generated by Go.

The repair lets the executing ordinary Array owner receive tokens and stack events, including generated or swallowed environment ends, nested owners, direct Pop, and restored lexical state. The source corridor covers all 31 selected Array, AlignedArray, MtMatrix, and MtSmallMatrix registrations. Literal Begin lookup also retains the original name and macro-charge order at padded or unknown environment names.

The matched fixture contains 5,852 cases; the disjoint residual fixture contains 272. Their union retains all 5,976 complete original SVG objects, including the 244 raw source-invalid XML strings, and every complete historical runtime object. The safe-XML comparison never rewrites the stored original or counts as raw SVG equality.

The qualified source change has 3,174 fixes (3,050 strict and 124 safe-XML), 2,678 preserved passing controls (2,558 strict and 120 safe-XML), zero regressions, and zero changed nonexact SVG outputs in this corpus. These counts are bound to source `3c9e0bd813e703c8bc95ce445ea3444222b63203`, internal tree `22b9b48a55288e64f6d44452501051b7d48facaf`, and the build/capture hashes in the inventory. Runtime outcome changes are classified separately from SVG fixes.

Against actual merged PR179, commit `a85eebdd12d60d7b24e0dd8b570e89baa4074d1f`, a recursive scan of all 512 tracked testdata JSON/JSON.gz paths and their consumers found:

- 5,898 first-published SVG inputs.

- Six preserved raw inputs promoted to matching assertions: four Quantity/Eval cases and two padded-name budget cases.
- Two prior augmented-package compiled-MML inputs receiving their first complete public SVG assertions.
- 148 first-published original runtime inputs.

Prior inputs are not counted as new parity inputs. All 6,244 source memberships remain attached to the 6,124 unique cases. The original 4,108 and 4,604 capture unions are unchanged; the last 1,520 inputs have fresh baseline captures, not fabricated historical baselines.

## Preserved limits

The 124 held SVG originals consist of 48 AlignedArray optional-setup cases, four dcases/drcases displaystyle cases, eight existing NumCases/SubNumCases direct-Pop finalization cases, and 64 displaylines center-alignment cases. They remain visible in the residual fixture and tests' accounting, without Go-rendered goldens or tests that insist the gaps remain.

The 148 original runtimes are separately bound to source failure classes: 14 missing-script cases, four U+0085 range cases, 124 missing spread-dimension cases, four missing Empheq-row cases, and two repeated SpreadLines-end cases. The 124 spread-dimension cases now reach the source failure boundary; 24 other bounded responses are unchanged. For the two inherited rendered controls, the test checks valid SVG XML and exactly `Extra \end{spreadlines}` as the diagnostic. They have no original SVG and are not SVG parity assertions.

## Public observations and separate augmented method evidence

Four observation files retain 772 complete source records over 770 existing public inputs: 222 primary, 406 corridor, 48 source repair, and 96 literal-Begin records. The first two streams overlap on two inputs. Every ordered event and complete original/observed output is retained; these observations add no public input.

The frozen public profile excludes newcommand and empheq. Its 192 newenvironment cases and 12 user-definition override cases are negative package controls, not evidence that those definitions executed. Historical `executedA` metadata means the supplied prefix-call count. When an unsupported declaration fails before the prefix, none of those calls execute. The metadata is preserved unchanged; actual execution claims use the source events and counters.

`ordinary_array_owner_augmented_methods.json.gz` is a separate set of 48 official-newcommand method records, using the pinned existing primary harness and explicitly seeded source macro count. It preserves requests and complete plain/observed responses, including their different traces. All output fields and complete trees agree between plain and observed calls. The original outcomes are 12 valid, 18 UnknownEnv, and 18 MaxMacroSub2.

The internal augmented test separately asserts 30 complete Begin-terminal outcomes, including error, count, tree and SVG, and 12 complete valid trees/SVGs. Twelve inherited successful-call counter gaps remain documented, and six original full-output cases at the user-defined End budget boundary remain held. No synthetic End replay, manual counter adjustment, Go counter golden, or claim of 48 matching Go outputs is used. None of these 48 method records is added to the public 6,124 inputs or the 772 public observation records.

## Reproduction

Use the three hash-verified frozen D2 assets in the inventory and the official MathJax 3.2.2 newcommand component with SHA256 `a41669a4ae924ab83cbc3d08f95ae90490a33cd649ed865e83675011b8708ab9`. The existing `macro_boundary_primary.js` must have SHA256 `e59040261f8024d42d1c1c1e5d893ab807f8d0625790d5242d215fc285a59432`.

```sh
node --jitless testdata/generate_ordinary_array_owner.cjs \
  /path/to/pinned-assets /path/to/new-scratch-output \
  /path/to/official-3.2.2/newcommand.js
```

The output directory must not exist. The generator never invokes Go. It recaptures all 5,976 complete public SVG objects, including held and raw unsafe originals, in fresh state; repeats all 772 public observation objects and all 48 augmented method records; and requires all seven regenerated gzip files to be byte-identical. Complete historical runtime objects remain unchanged, with every fresh full exception retained separately in the regeneration receipt. A changed stack callsite is reported as full-object inequality and may only pass the separately bound original first-line failure contract. A changed failure class, unexpected successful SVG, protocol failure, or timeout fails regeneration.

The inventory records exact fixture hashes and separate source/candidate, original-regeneration, test, and D2 evidence bindings. Successful source regeneration does not substitute for the root-run Go checks and full gates.

The recorded regeneration passed: all seven compressed files are byte-identical after recapturing every public SVG, all 772 public observation objects, and all 48 augmented method records. All 148 fresh runtime objects also exactly match their complete historical exceptions; both records are retained separately in the receipt. The root-run selected public and augmented Go tests also passed. The full frozen-oracle repository suite, race tests, vet and WebAssembly build passed at `c56239e274e5ee8f98802bf95e295f503c89e1ce`, with the pinned original assets and Node runtime recorded in the inventory. Finalization changes this README, validation metadata and the CI race-test timeout; production, tests, fixtures, generator and D2 evidence remain identical to that tested revision. Both hosted race jobs at `92805df52a404ce903159a746da2f4f6b13a0251` exceeded Go's default ten-minute package timeout after the frozen-oracle tests passed. Neither failed log reports an assertion failure or data race. The CI command now uses a finite twenty-minute timeout while retaining the full race suite. Updated hosted checks must complete on the exact publication head before merge.

The D2 evidence uses swallowed-end, generated-end, and direct-Pop witnesses. Root's final source-bound D2 render matches the original SVG byte-for-byte for all three, with before/after/original screenshots. The evidence files are under `parity/ordinary-array-swallowed-end`, `parity/ordinary-array-generated-end`, and `parity/ordinary-array-direct-pop`; all three common-scale screenshots were visually inspected, and all 93 prior D2 witnesses also remain byte-identical to their original references.
